acceptanceCriteria: An order-independence review of both packages is retained.
They are allow-listed and sliced, or the reason they cannot be is recorded; predicted and observed max shard retained.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the CI-speed lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1105, head c464ca833, AFP-V0-060; costs from merge_group run 39120414701). title: CI shards: internal/tasks/cli (467 s) and internal/tasks/authority (442 s) are not slice-allow-listed and set the next shard floor
